communications.subject: Arizona Public Records Law Request: SLIC
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

- Email and email attachments between any member of the Arizona State Senate or the Arizona House of Representatives, or any member of their legislative staff, and any representative of the State Legislators Israel Caucus, including any email address ending in @statelegislatorisraelcaucus.com, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between any member of the Arizona State Senate or the Arizona House of Representatives, or any member of their legislative staff, and any official, employee, or agent of the Government of Israel or of the Embassy of Israel to the United States, including any email address ending in @gov.il, regarding the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC), the "50 States, One Israel" delegation, or the "50 States, One Nation" conference held in Israel in September 2025, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Calendar entries, meeting invitations, and scheduling records for any member of the Arizona State Senate or the Arizona House of Representatives concerning the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" / "50 States, One Nation" conference, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Records of travel, lodging, or expenses paid for, reimbursed to, or arranged for any member of the Arizona State Senate or the Arizona House of Representatives in connection with the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" conference, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request, including reimbursement forms, expense reports, and travel or gift disclosures.

- Records identifying the source of funding for the participation of any member of the Arizona State Senate or the Arizona House of Representatives in the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" conference.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti

title: Itemized Fee Petitions, Invoices, and Settlement Payouts (McMinimee Law)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All itemized invoices, line-item billing sheets, and fee petitions submitted to the Wenatchee School District, its legal affairs department, or its risk-management carriers by Shannon McMinimee or any agent operating under the domain or entity name "McMinimee Law".
2. All transactional records, ledger entries, checks, or electronic funds transfer records documenting attorney fee payouts, cost reimbursements, or financial settlement distributions paid directly to McMinimee Law or Shannon McMinimee.
3. The chronological scope of this request spans from January 1, 2022, through June 3, 2025, specifically targeting all billing blocks and fee recovery actions generated while the attorney was concurrently operating under private credentials and public employment contracts.

PRE-EMPTIVE STATUTORY ENFORCEMENT & COMPLIANCE CLAUSE:
The District is advised that, per Washington law (Progressive Animal Welfare Soc. v. University of Wash.), attorney billing records for public payment are subject to disclosure. Only specific, narrow redactions (e.g., student names under FERPA) are permitted, as blanket privilege claims are invalid under Soter v. Cowles Publishing Co.

MANDATORY STATUTORY COMPLIANCE TIMELINE:
A response is expected within five business days as per RCW 42.56.520. The records, requested for non-commercial purposes, should be provided electronically.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kung Fu Joe

communications.subject: Arizona Public Records Law Request: Flock Saftey FOIA
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

in possession of, or available to, The City Of Safford, Arizona, The Safford Police Department:, 
1. THE CONTRACT
The complete current contract, all purchase orders, and any amendments or renewals with Flock
Safety Inc. or any ALPR vendor — including the total cost, contract term, payment schedule, and any
automatic renewal provisions.
2. DATA RETENTION POLICY
The complete written policy governing how long license plate images, timestamps, location data, and
associated metadata are retained before deletion.
3. USE POLICY
Any written policy, general order, directive, or memorandum of understanding governing who may
conduct searches of ALPR data and what justification is required before a search may be run.
5. OUTSIDE AGENCY ACCESS
A complete list of every agency outside Safford, AZ — including local, county, state, federal, or out-of-
state agencies — that has been granted access to or has queried Safford, AZ ALPR data, along with
copies of any data-sharing agreements, memoranda of understanding, or written authorizations.
6. AUDITS AND REVIEWS
Any internal review, third-party audit, inspector general report, or other formal assessment of ALPR
system use, access patterns, data security, or potential misuse.
7. COMMUNICATIONS WITH FLOCK SAFETY
All written communications between Safford, AZ, officials and Flock Safety Inc. representatives
concerning: data sharing, the Flock national network, system audits, access by outside agencies,
immigration enforcement, civil liberties, or public records requests — for the period
1/1/2024-10/1/2026.
8. COMMUNICATIONS WITH FLOCK SAFETY
All written communications between Safford, AZ, officials and Flock Safety Inc. representatives
concerning: Flock Safety Camera Vulnerabilities including CVE-2025-59403, CVE-2025-59407, CVE-2025-59405, 
CVE-2025-59409, CVE-2025-59406, CVE-2025-47822, CVE-2025-47823,CVE-2025-47824

FORMAT: Please provide all responsive records electronically, via e-mail attachment.
For any record withheld in whole or in part, please cite the specific statutory exemption
for each item and provide all reasonably segregable non-exempt material. 

FEE WAIVER REQUEST: I request a complete waiver of all fees as this request is in the 
public interest, is NOT for commercial use, and will contribute to public understanding of government 
surveillance operations in Safford, AZ.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Hue Pathfinder
